description: Budget document year (the source folder year, e.g. 2024-25). Identifies which year's budget publication this row comes from.
Two-letter state code (always TN in this package).
Printed page number within the per-demand source PDF (as extracted from the page).
1-based position of the row in the year's combined extraction CSV — the stable row address used in NDJSON _ids.
Source table family. TN detailed pages are one uniform table, so this is constant (contrast KA's object_head/minor_head/sub_major_head).
Printed row role. TN emits no Header rows (page headers carry no data); non-leaf Data rows are hierarchy name-carriers.
Hierarchy level of the row. The -Net/-Gross/-Grand major-head levels are the recoveries ladder (Deduct-Recoveries reconciliation rows); they are not check targets.
Printed English description of the row.
Demand (grant) number, zero-padded to 2 digits. TN-specific: the demand PDF is the publication unit.
Printed demand name for this document year (canonical map in demand_names.json; printed names vary across years).
TN-specific: Head of Department code as printed (e.g. '005 03'). A demand spans multiple HODs.
4-digit major head code.
Major head name as printed.
2-digit sub-major head code ('00' when none).
Sub-major head name as printed.
3-digit minor head code.
Minor head name as printed.

TN-specific: printed plan-band / funding-source label (e.g. "State's Expenditure", 'I.Non-Plan'). A label carried forward across a page break is kept verbatim here; the checks re-attribute bands positionally.
2-letter sub-head (scheme) code, e.g. 'AA'.
Sub-head (scheme) name as printed.
Detailed head code as printed WITH its group prefix (3 digits in the IFHRMS era, e.g. '301').
Detailed head name.
TN-specific additive leaf level (fills KA's object_head slot): 2-digit sub-detailed head code.
Sub-detailed head name.
Full D P Code exactly as printed, space-separated (e.g. '2011 02 101 AA 30101').
Charged/Voted marker, kept verbatim (the extraction never invents values, so rare stray labels appear as printed).
Position-1 amount: Accounts (actuals) of document year minus 2, in INR thousand. Column name carries the fiscal year and the _inThous unit suffix (TN is INR_thousand; KA is INR_lakh).
Position-2 amount: Budget Estimate of document year minus 1, INR thousand.
Position-3 amount: Revised Estimate of document year minus 1, INR thousand.
Position-4 amount: Budget Estimate of the document year, INR thousand.
Unit of the four amount columns. Divide by 100,000 for INR crore; by 100 for INR lakh.
Package-relative path of the per-demand source PDF.
Whether a validation check anchors on this row.
Links this printed Total row to its comparisons in checks_<year>.csv. A Charged/Voted split total shares one reference_check_id: the check compares the summed pair.
Number of attached comparisons that passed.
Percentage of attached comparisons that passed.
Sum of abs_diff across attached comparisons, INR thousand.
